_why: Scenarios that cannot be captured against the development tenant as it stands, and the reason for each. A scenario listed here still skips - but it skips saying why, so nobody mistakes an obstacle for an oversight. Recording wins: if a golden for one of these ever appears, the spec runs and tests/unit/golden/README.md says to delete the entry. Anything NOT listed here and not recorded is simply awaiting a capture.

contract-list.page 2: the demo tenant holds fewer contracts than one page, so no pagination control renders
contract-list.search surviving a page change: needs two pages of contracts; see page 2

module-list.page 2: the demo tenant holds fewer modules than one page, so no pagination control renders
module-list.search surviving a page change: needs two pages of modules; see page 2

member-list.initial load as staff: needs a staff login that is not a superuser, which the demo tenant has no account for
